description: This file implements a stock aging report in ERPNext, including functions for data retrieval, processing FIFO stock queues, calculating age ranges, and generating report columns and chart data.

methods.name: get_average_age
methods.description: Calculates the average age of stock batches in FIFO queue as of a given date.

methods.name: get_range_age
methods.description: Determines the quantity of stock in different age ranges based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the stock aging report, including optional warehouse-wise stock.

methods.name: get_fifo_queue
methods.description: Builds FIFO queue of stock batches from stock ledger entries, considering serial numbers and transfers.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_item_conditions
methods.description: Constructs SQL conditions for item code and brand filters.

methods.name: get_sle_conditions
methods.description: Constructs SQL conditions for warehouse filters.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares chart data for the report, showing average age per item.

methods.name: setup_ageing_columns
methods.description: Sets up age range columns for the report based on filter ranges.

methods.name: add_column
methods.description: Adds a column definition to the range columns list.
